zh: 前 k 名地区就是观众数最大的 k 个，与它们原来的位置无关。
所有查询都基于同一个数组，排一次序之后就能反复使用。
把观众数降序排序并求前缀和 prefix[k]，每个查询直接输出 prefix[k]；最大和约 10^14，用 64 位。
en: The top k regions are simply the k largest viewer counts, regardless of their original positions.
All queries use the same array, so a single sort can serve all of them.
Sort the counts in descending order, build prefix sums prefix[k], and answer each query with prefix[k]; sums reach about 10^14, so use 64 bits.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the viewer counts in descending order and build prefix sums; the k-th prefix is the answer to query k.

## Proof of correctness

If a chosen set misses a larger value, swapping it in does not decrease the sum; repeated swaps give the first k values in descending order. So their sum is the maximum, and the prefix sums store that sum exactly.

## Complexity

O(n log n+q) time and O(n+q) space; the largest answer is 10^14.
